sentences.en: Judy spends a lot of time looking in the mirror.
sentences.zh: 朱迪花很多时间照镜子。

sentences.en: I like to have a full-length mirror in my bedroom.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢在我的卧室里放一个全身镜。

sentences.en: She's always looking at herself in the mirror - What vanity.
sentences.zh: 她总是对着镜子看自己——真是虚荣心重。
